    Pipeline

    From 1.5 GB of JSON to this page

    Each script reads the previous step's output. The raw exports are read straight out of the zip, one file at a time, so peak memory stays under a few hundred MB. Parsing both years takes about a minute.

      Definitions

      • Keep RCV is a No vote on Ballot Measure 2, as a share of Yes + No. Overvotes, blanks and partially counted ballots are left out.
      • First choice follows Alaska's tabulation rules: an overvoted rank ends the ballot, two skipped ranks in a row exhaust it, a repeated candidate counts once at their highest rank, and write-ins are set aside before round one.
      • Ranked means two or more valid choices in that contest after those rules.
      • Crossover is a Trump voter voting to keep RCV or a Harris voter voting to repeal it, as a share of Trump + Harris voters with a Yes/No vote.
      • Partial counting. Questioned and some absentee ballots count only in the races the voter was eligible for. The 2024 CVR marks those contests with IsVote=false on clean marks. They are excluded, not treated as blanks.
      • Precinct maps use election-day ballots only. Alaska files absentee, early and questioned ballots under district-wide pseudo-precincts ("District 18 – Absentee"), so only of 2024 ballots can be placed in a precinct. District maps use every ballot.

      Spatial autocorrelation

      Global Moran's I with six-nearest-neighbor weights between precinct centroids, 999 permutations. Every measure clusters strongly, which is why the explorer offers local cluster maps.

      Caveats

      • Precinct patterns are ecological. A precinct where many Trump voters kept RCV does not tell you which individual voters did; the ballot-level findings do.
      • The link between ranking and supporting RCV is a correlation. People who already liked RCV may have chosen to rank.
      • The CVR omits hand-counted precincts (Chevak and most of Tuluksak in 2024; a few small villages in 2022) and predates the December 2024 recount.
      • Census context is from 2020 block counts assigned to 2024 precinct shapes by block centroid.

      Sources
